quality.notes: The bound set applies to expression names, including an index expression, but assignment lvalues designate state. Thus a forall binder shadowing a state name can intentionally remain unqualified on the RHS while the assignment target resolves to the component state; passing bound into rewrite_lvalue is needed for index expressions and does not imply that target names should honor it.

The source value is selected only when it is SpecItem::Action, and rewrite_component_item's Action arm unconditionally returns SpecItem::Action. The else branch therefore expresses a locally established invariant; a hypothetical future change is not a current trigger or actionable defect.

The code deliberately combines all component and compose init statements into one SpecItem::Init, whose model has only one optional meta value, while separately merging every annotation. First-wins selection for the singleton metadata field is explicit, and the available source provides no evidence that each input init's metadata must be preserved as per-component provenance.
